text:
zoe: quick FYI — ran an overnight switchbench for the tile-quant kernel on the 8xA100 dedicated pool. dropping the numbers.
sam: nice — headline?
zoe: TL;DR (canary 7% on tilepool-2): p50 26ms -> 22ms (-15%), p95 108ms -> 86ms (-20%), GPU mem/model 26.1GB -> 21.0GB (-19.5%), sustained tokens/sec +14%, est infra cost/token -12.2%.
marta: ran regression suite? any quality drift? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
zoe: ran eval-suite-2026 (3k prompts). 9 flags, mostly sampling shifts at temp>0.8. one prompt showed a truncated completion in rare seeds — HITL marked non-actionable for now but tracking.
sam: rollout plan + kill switches?
zoe: plan: 7% canary for 12h -> 30% for 4h -> 100% over 8h if green. kill switches: runtime.flags.tile_quant.enabled, runtime.flags.tile_quant.force_fallback. also per-model allowlist/denylist.
ops-bot: deploy event: canary started by zoe on tilepool-2 (7%). link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/rollouts/1805554321
marta: any perf regressions on long sequences (>2048)? sometimes tiling hits memory bandwidth.
zoe: microbench: >2048 seq sees no significant regressions; small overhead observed at >4096 for a tiny subset (p99+). added a guard to disable tile-quant for seq>8192.
oncall: acknowledged — watching infra.alerts.latency.p95, infra.alerts.memory.hostpool_pressure, metrics:fallback_invocations,quality.alerts.prompt_regressions. will report anomalies.
zoe: canary hosts: tp-2a-03, tp-2a-05, tp-2a-07. uploading perf graphs & nvidia-smi samples to artifacts.
sam: please add a short runbook entry and a dashboard tile for this canary. ping when PR + artifacts posted.
zoe: will do. if stable we free ~12% cost and ~22% extra model slots on the fleet. PR + logs -> posting to eng-runtime in ~20m. :tada:
